description: Canonical CBOR (RFC 8949 section 4.2.1) encoding vectors: 'valid' entries map a diagnostic-notation value to its unique canonical encoding (encoders MUST produce exactly 'hex'; decoders MUST accept it); 'invalid' entries MUST be rejected by the strict decoder with the given error code (see WIRE_FORMAT.md section 2).

invalid.name: keys sorted length-first (RFC 7049) instead of bytewise
depth 17 (16 nested arrays around a value)
